Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vihaan - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Savitri - 69 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Zoya - 12 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan is sitting on a chair in the living room. Anjali, Zoya and Riya stand near him.]

Anjali: "Riya, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan stands up.]

Zoya: "Vihaan, listen!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan jumps with joy.]

Anjali (gently): "Well done!"

[Vihaan shouts angrily.]

Vihaan (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Vihaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Vihaan (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
